component.name: Slimcast
component.summary: Compress your OBS recordings to HEVC and get your disk space back
Comprime tus grabaciones de OBS a HEVC y recupera espacio en el disco

description.p: Slimcast converts your OBS recordings and streams to HEVC (H.265) on your GPU or CPU, with no visible quality loss.

ul.li: NVIDIA (NVENC), AMD and Intel (VAAPI) or the CPU
Never touches the originals: output goes to a comprimidos folder next to each video
Checks free disk space first and shows how much you can free up
Copies every audio track as is and can lower the video to 30 fps
In English, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese and Korean
